notes: Printing: PRINT > PRINTER finds AirPrint / IPP printers on the house WiFi (or takes an address), prints a test page, and can be forgotten.
Printing: PRINT on any card sends it to that printer at real card size (63 mm wide) on letter or A4; copies print as pages.
Printing: written to the IPP, PWG Raster and Apple URF specs; the Bluetooth T02 link comes next and will reuse the same rows.
